newsitem.title: USA: US stocks flirt with highs as rate picture elates.
newsitem.headline: US stocks flirt with highs as rate picture elates.

text.p: Wall Street stocks approached session highs in mid-afternoon on Wednesday, as investors basked in the steadily improving interest rate environment.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up 72 points at 8247, near their day's high of 8263. The long bond held steady at its sharply higher levels, rising 25/32 to yield 6.33 percent.
"This is purely rate-driven," said Richard Cripps, chief market strategist at Legg Mason Wood Walker. "What justifies this market is lower interest rates."
The Nasdaq Composite gained 15 points to 1587.
